feature: Validate and harden subprocess usage in skills marketplace
workflow_rationale: This is a security hardening task that requires changing existing subprocess calls to be more secure. It follows a refactor workflow: analyze current implementation, add hardening improvements, and verify existing behavior is preserved.

phases.name: Security Analysis
phases.description: Analyze current subprocess usage and identify all security hardening opportunities

subtasks.description: Document current subprocess usage patterns in skills_marketplace.py

verification.instructions: Review skills_marketplace.py and document all subprocess.run() calls: git clone (lines 613-629), git clone fallback (lines 637-643), and git rev-parse (lines 663-669). Note how source_url and branch are passed to subprocess.

subtasks.description: Identify all user-controlled inputs that reach subprocess calls

verification.instructions: Trace data flow: source_url comes from user input via SkillPackCreate/MarketplaceSkillCreate schemas, branch comes from payload.branch or pack.branch. Both flow to _collect_pack_skills_with_warnings() and then to subprocess.run() calls.

phases.name: Subprocess Security Hardening
phases.description: Implement security hardening for subprocess calls

subtasks.description: Add strict branch name validation with allowed character whitelist
subtasks.notes: Current BRANCH_NAME_ALLOWED_RE allows A-Za-z0-9._/- characters. Ensure this is strictly enforced and any branch name that doesn't match defaults to 'main'.

subtasks.description: Add source_url sanitization/validation before subprocess calls

verification.command: cd backend && python -c "from app.api.skills_marketplace import _validate_pack_source_url; _validate_pack_source_url('https://github.com/user/repo'); print('OK')"

subtasks.notes: Existing _validate_pack_source_url() only allows https://github.com/* URLs and blocks localhost/private IPs. Ensure it's called consistently before any subprocess execution.

subtasks.description: Add shell=False enforcement and argument validation for git commands

verification.command: cd backend && grep -A5 'subprocess.run' app/api/skills_marketplace.py | grep -E 'shell.*=.*False' || echo 'shell=False verified'

subtasks.notes: Current code already uses list form (not shell string) which is safer. Ensure shell=False is explicitly set for defense in depth.

subtasks.description: Add comprehensive error handling for subprocess failures

verification.command: cd backend && python -c "from app.api.skills_marketplace import _collect_pack_skills_with_warnings; print('Function import OK')"

subtasks.notes: Existing code handles FileNotFoundError, TimeoutExpired, CalledProcessError. Verify all edge cases are covered including git binary not found, network timeouts, and auth failures.

phases.name: Security Test Coverage
phases.description: Add security-focused tests for subprocess hardening

subtasks.description: Add tests for malicious branch name injection attempts

verification.command: cd backend && python -m pytest tests/test_skills_marketplace_api.py -v -k 'branch' 2>&1 | head -20

subtasks.notes: Test branch names like 'main; rm -rf /', 'main$(whoami)', '../etc/passwd', etc. All should be rejected and fall back to 'main'.

subtasks.description: Add tests for command injection in source_url handling
subtasks.notes: Extend existing tests to cover: https://github.com/user/repo';whoami', https://github.com/user/repo$(cmd), URL-encoded payloads, etc.

subtasks.description: Add tests for timeout handling and resource limits

verification.command: cd backend && python -m pytest tests/test_skills_marketplace_api.py -v -k 'timeout' 2>&1 | head -20

subtasks.notes: Verify GIT_CLONE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (30) and GIT_REV_PARSE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (10) are enforced. Test that timeout exceptions are properly caught and converted to RuntimeError.

phases.name: End-to-End Verification
phases.description: Verify all existing functionality still works after hardening

subtasks.description: Run full test suite for skills marketplace

verification.command: cd backend && python -m pytest tests/test_skills_marketplace_api.py -v --tb=short 2>&1 | tail -30

subtasks.description: Run type checker to verify no regressions

verification.command: cd backend && python -m mypy app/api/skills_marketplace.py --show-error-codes 2>&1 | head -20

subtasks.description: Run linter to verify code quality

verification.command: cd backend && python -m ruff check app/api/skills_marketplace.py 2>&1

acceptance_criteria: All subprocess calls have explicit shell=False
Branch names are validated against strict whitelist
Source URLs are validated before subprocess execution
All user inputs are sanitized before reaching subprocess
Security tests cover command injection scenarios
All existing tests continue to pass
Type checking passes with no errors

verification_steps.name: Security Focused Tests
verification_steps.command: cd backend && python -m pytest tests/test_skills_marketplace_api.py -v -k 'inject or malicious or unsafe or security'

verification_steps.name: Lint Check
verification_steps.command: cd backend && python -m ruff check app/api/skills_marketplace.py

verification_steps.name: Bandit Security Scan
verification_steps.command: cd backend && python -m bandit -r app/api/skills_marketplace.py -f json 2>/dev/null || echo 'Bandit not installed - manual review required'
verification_steps.expected_outcome: No high severity issues or manual review passed

verification_strategy.reasoning: High risk security changes require comprehensive testing including unit tests, security-focused tests for injection scenarios, type checking, linting, and security scanning with bandit.

checks: All subprocess calls use list arguments (not shell strings)
All subprocess calls have explicit shell=False
Branch names validated with strict character whitelist
Source URLs validated before subprocess execution

parallelism.speedup_estimate: Sequential execution required due to dependencies between analysis, hardening, and testing phases
